claims.assertion: Swaruu 9 characterizes terrestrial science as materialist, reductionist, and deterministic, discounting consciousness, intuition, and nonphysical realms.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: This is her critique of Earth science.

claims.assertion: She argues determinism encourages people to surrender agency to authorities and says controllers deliberately constrain science to direct human perception and preserve power.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as intentional social control.
